hooks.name: spec-progress-on-spawn
hooks.description: Inject open spec tasks so every session starts from the plan, not from memory.

hooks.name: typecheck-after-write
hooks.description: Typecheck the package a file was written in. Warn only.

hooks.name: tests-green-before-stop
hooks.description: Run core tests at the end of a turn. If red, keep the agent working instead of stopping.

hooks.name: single-transition-table
hooks.description: Block edits that redefine the status transition table outside packages/core/src/status.ts.
